build_TransformerModel: build a TransformerModel encoder or decoder with configurable heads, layers, and positional embeddings
run_generate_beam: run beam search decoding on a TransformerModel to generate sequences from encoder output
create_MultiHeadAttention: create a MultiHeadAttention module with optional normalized attention and KV caching support
review_top_k_top_p_filtering: review the top_k_top_p_filtering function to apply nucleus and top-k filtering on logits
test_BeamHypotheses: test the BeamHypotheses class to manage n-best hypotheses with length penalty scoring
